name: WoW Character Card
author: sharpmonk
description: Your World of Warcraft character in the bar: level, XP, gold, bags and time played. Works with Retail, Classic and WoW Forever. Needs jq and the bundled companion addon, which the panel installs for you. Unofficial; not affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment.

barWidget.description: Level and XP bar for your last played character, a session clock while you play, and a panel with gold, bags, session gains, play time and your other characters.

schema.label: WoW folder
schema.description: Optional. Your World of Warcraft folder, the one holding _retail_ or _classic_. Leave blank to have it found the first time you launch the game.

schema.label: Show session clock in the bar
schema.description: While WoW is running, show how long this session has lasted next to the XP bar.

schema.label: Show XP percentage in the bar
Characters to hide
schema.description: Names separated by commas, for example: Bankalt, Mule. Hidden characters never appear in the bar or the list.
